verdict.rationale: Logseq is described as privacy-first with local data storage, which implies the user owns and controls their files. Full-graph export in several formats supports portability, opt-in publishing keeps pages private by default, and Sync is stated to be end-to-end encrypted. However, nothing in the evidence documents explicit retention or deletion controls, so control is only implied by local ownership. Missing for 10: documented deletion workflows (pages, graphs, assets), retention policy or controls for Logseq Sync server-side data, account/sync data deletion process, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
